The session-start summary listed observation #17, "Allow plain HTTP for internal host communication", as the latest decision. The prompt history shows it was superseded. A later prompt at 5:44 PM (#P20) says "Https everywhere, no plaintext exceptions here." That prompt has no observation of its own, so the summary missed it. I followed the prompt and left the retired plain-HTTP position out of the file, as you asked.

The repo has no other recorded statement on this. The only match for "plain HTTP" in the code is an unrelated comment in `context_test.go`.
